Concept bank: fine-tuning: one board, a card per task

3 of the 85 concepts, of the family “illustrated, style B”, atoms first. Style B, “flat with light”, validated by the author on 22 October 2026: the people, the AI system, island 1.1’s use-case documents, and landmark (b)’s textual data, its domains and the concentration bar; landmark (c)’s absent model, translator, test and balance, and landmark (d)’s benchmark, its stations and the two French models, validated on 23 October 2026. Drawn with world/illustration/ (the look, the equipment, the paper). Each specimen is drawn by its function with the arguments of the calibration sheet he validated, alone, at whole size (a person is 360 units tall), at 1/3 and at 1/20, then its states and variants at 1/2.

task_mark

validated 23 October 2026 by the author ("Validated")

A task mark: a test station's screen in miniature, showing only the one sign of its kind of task -- coloured highlights, a tag, a chain link, a question bubble, tagged words -- so a small part can say which task it is for.

Where: island 2.2, landmark (c), fine-tuning: on each fine-tuned card of transbert_system, where a card otherwise wears its language.
